high_level_description: The image is a triptych-style artwork featuring three distinct faces, each rendered in a different color scheme and style. The central figure is depicted in red, with sharp, jagged lines extending upwards from the top of the head, giving it an aggressive and intense appearance. This figure has a fierce expression, with wide eyes and an open mouth showing teeth, suggesting a state of anger or aggression. On either side of the central figure are two more faces, both in grayscale tones.
